name: cursor-agent-host
description: Hosts Cursor agent orchestration in the AgentExec extension host

cursorAgentHost.experimentalHostOwnedSes.description: Experimental. Store new agent chats in per-session databases owned by the agent host, under the extension's global storage, mirroring every write to the renderer's store; existing chats stay where they are. Read when the agent host starts, so a change takes effect after a window reload. The CURSOR_AGENT_HOST_OWNED_SESSION_STORAGE environment variable (1 or true) turns this on too.

enumDescriptions: On remote windows, probe AgentService egress once and pick the remote network or the local-client hop.
On remote windows, always route AgentService through the local client. No probe.
On remote windows, always use the remote's own network. No probe, no hop.
cursorAgentHost.remoteInferenceRoute.description: How the agent host routes AgentService on remote windows (Remote-SSH, WSL, containers). Same enum shape as remote.SSH.localServerDownload. machine-overridable so a per-remote settings.json can force always or never for one box. Local windows ignore this setting. Read once when the agent host starts; a change takes effect after a window reload. always is ignored on a private-inference remote because the local hop skips CPI.
